name: lean-workflow
description: Token-efficient, self-improving Claude Code workflow: usage dashboard and guards, model rungs, read-only scout and independent reviewer agents, a code map, orient and gate scripts, size warnings, a habit coach with /coach, live limit bars and a tier that follows the weekly limit, modes (focus, triage, review, budget, release), guards and a morning briefing for unattended runs, an end-of-session retro, a per-item rung ledger and a weekly upgrade-scan.

grepOnly.title: Grep-only files
grepOnly.description: Regex of paths that must never be read whole (read a line range instead).

claudeMdMaxLines.title: CLAUDE.md line limit
claudeMdMaxLines.description: Warn when CLAUDE.md is read whole or written past this many lines.

nowMaxLines.title: now.md line limit
nowMaxLines.description: Warn when .claude/now.md is read whole or written past this many lines.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: max or pro. The live limits raise it on their own: pro at 70% weekly (one agent, no Opus, budget mode), stop at your finish-up line.

finishAtWeek.title: Finish up at weekly %
finishAtWeek.description: Weekly usage at which the model is told to finish the step, commit, push and stop (an active work order is marked stopped). You can also say it in a prompt: "finish up at 60% weekly".

coachOff.title: Habit coach: habits to silence
coachOff.description: Comma-separated habits the coach should not count or show: longSession, longPr, agentModel, bigPaste, bigImage, idleGap, weeklyLimit, reread, fanOut.
